summary: Verified refresh/reload bug fix. Logged in as robeson.constantine@gmail.com, reloaded '/' four times consecutively — dashboard-kpis remained visible each time and onboarding never appeared. Reloaded /instellingen, /bouwdepot, /potjes — user stayed on route, no redirect to /onboarding. The `ready` gating in AppContext + Shell + Onboarding.jsx resolves the race condition described by the user.
action_items: Minor (not part of this bug): No element with data-testid='logout-btn' was found on the dashboard, so the logout regression couldn't be executed via testid. Consider adding data-testid on the logout control for future automated tests.
Console noise: many Recharts 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on dashboard reloads. Non-blocking, cosmetic.
critical_code_review_comments: AppContext `ready` flag correctly gates the onboarding redirect; verified via 4x page.reload() on '/' with no bounce to /onboarding.
Onboarding.jsx guard `<Navigate to='/' replace/>` when currentHousehold exists is honored — reloading directly on / (or any authed route) never rendered the household-name-input.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for reload bug scenarios (4/4 root refreshes + 3/3 other routes)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Refresh-race bug is fixed. If revisiting, note that logout button lacks a data-testid — full logout+login regression via testid was skipped for that reason but is not related to the reported bug.
rca of the issue: Original race: on reload, checkAuth resolved /auth/me and setUser fired before loadHouseholds() completed, so Shell briefly saw user && !currentHousehold and Navigated to /onboarding, which then stayed rendered. Fix: a `ready` flag in AppContext is set to true only in checkAuth's finally block after both /auth/me and loadHouseholds() resolve; Shell shows 'Laden...' while !ready and only redirects to /onboarding when ready && user && !currentHousehold. Onboarding.jsx additionally short-circuits back to '/' via <Navigate replace/> if currentHousehold exists. Verified with 4 consecutive reloads on '/' and reloads on /instellingen, /bouwdepot, /potjes — no bounce to onboarding in any case.
